text: 科创50指数涨超9%，创业板指涨超6%，沪指涨1.93%，深成指涨3.93%，贵金属、光伏、半导体芯片、医药生物等方向涨幅居前，沪深京三市上涨个股近4700只
text_en: STAR 50 Index rises over 9%, ChiNext Index up over 6%, Shanghai Composite up 1.93%, Shenzhen Component up 3.93%, precious metals, solar, semiconductor chips and biopharma lead gains, nearly 4,700 stocks advance across Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets
